bead.title: Make composed atomic update_fields conformance non-vacuous
bead.description: PROBLEM: the claimed-item update_fields scenario is skipped for composed atomic backends, so the non-relational family does not prove the update_fields path. ROOT CAUSE: `crates/pqueue-conformance/src/lib.rs:315-327` returns early when `caps.consistency.contains(`composed`)`, even though composed atomic backends still support `update_fields` (`crates/pqueue-engine/src/compose.rs:2379-2383`). PROPOSED FIX: replace the substring gate with a real capability check (`commit_capabilities().is_atomic()` or an `EngineError::Unavailable` probe) so composed atomic backends execute the scenario. NON-SCOPE: postgres provisioning, RESP wire assertions, reserved-name policy, and whole_group coverage. Parent bead pqueue-7bed1610; review basis dbf97f1/14d04ac on beads pqueue-46ea00f4 and pqueue-5c70706b.
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestComposedAtomicUpdateFieldsExecutes` proves the claimed-item update_fields scenario runs on composed atomic backends and records at least one assertion.
2. `TestCapabilityGateUsesAtomicProbe` proves the skip is capability-based and still excludes eventual-apply backends.
3. `go test ./...` passes.
4. `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
